display.title: Rosh Chodesh Nissan: The Month of Miracles
display.summary_short: Welcoming Rosh Chodesh Nissan: the six blessings we ask for the new month, why Nissan is named for miracles, and why now is the time to call out 'Ad Mosai'.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast on Rosh Chodesh Nissan. Uncle Yossi recalls the prayer said on Shabbos Mevarchim, asking Hashem for life and peace, happiness and joy, and deliverance and consolation, which together are everything we need to serve Hashem well; the deliverance and consolation mean the coming of Moshiach. Nissan is the month in which we left Egypt, and our Sages explain that its name holds the letters nun and samach, spelling nes, a miracle, because so many miracles happened in it. Since Hashem listens to every prayer, this month is the right time to call out two special words, 'Ad Mosai', how much longer must we wait, because we want Moshiach now.
display.lesson: Nissan is a month of miracles; ask Hashem sincerely for the Geulah and believe He will answer.
